lines.say: The terms and conditions of your revision timetable.
Clause one. It was written for a week with no surprises.
Clause two. One late night, and the whole thing's out of date.
Clause three. It expires on Wednesday.
Or skip the contract. Offload builds your plan from your notes and exam dates.
It moves when your week does, and tests you as you go.
You just click the link in your calendar.
